name: Client pass
description: Guided checks for what only a player in the real game can confirm: the status page's rows awaiting a game test and the open client checklists, ordered into sessions (docs/kiln/client-pass.md). Open the list with Ctrl+Shift+F5. Uses the sample mods for content and says which one to add when it is missing. Verdicts go to kiln/state/client-checks.json; tools/client-checks/report.py reads them.
